newsitem.title: USA: Amtech to hire advisor to mull strategies.
newsitem.headline: Amtech to hire advisor to mull strategies.

text.p: Amtech Corp said Wednesday it plans to hire an investment banking firm and will explore strategic options, after reporting a first quarter loss of $0.22 a share, compared to a year-ago profit of $0.02 a share.
The company said the first quarter results "are not indicative of our expectations for the business.

"First-quarter ending consolidated order backlog stood at $47 million, a company record-high, and business activity in the second quarter in our established business units appears to support a return to historic revenue run rates in the second quarter," the company said in a statement.
The company said it is re-evaluating its operations and managing expenses aggressively.
"To assist us in reviewing strategic alternatives for creating shareholder value in the near-term, the company will shortly retain an investment banking firm," the company statement said.
